title: Right to Local Intelligence
summary: A manifesto and advocacy platform calling for the fundamental right to run AI models locally on personal devices, emphasizing digital sovereignty, privacy, and autonomy from cloud-based AI services controlled by large corporations.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing dependency on cloud-based AI services that compromise user privacy and create centralized control over AI infrastructure.
why_valuable: Champions the principle that individuals should have the freedom to run AI locally, protecting privacy and preventing monopoly control over AI capabilities.
